title: Cwm LLC Sells 42,655 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Cwm LLC lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 49.3% during the second the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 43,890 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 42,655 shares during the period. Cwm LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,125,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other large investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. First Hawaiian Bank boosted its position in Apple by 33.5% during the second quarter. First Hawaiian Bank now owns 10,012 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,854,000 after purchasing an additional 2,510 shares in the last quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 44.0% during the first quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. now owns 42,322 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,101,000 after purchasing an additional 12,930 shares in the last quarter. Peavine Capital LLC boosted its position in Apple by 428.7% during the second quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 6,968 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,290,000 after purchasing an additional 5,650 shares in the last quarter. Nikulski Financial Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 1.6% during the first quarter. Nikulski Financial Inc. now owns 26,051 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,371,000 after purchasing an additional 407 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Spectrum Management Group Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 20.1% during the first quarter. Spectrum Management Group Inc. now owns 23,228 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,897,000 after purchasing an additional 3,880 shares in the last quarter. 57.65% of the stock is currently owned by and hedge funds.
